pinned_body:
::CoffeeScript.compile content
rescue ExecJS::RuntimeError => e
  errors.add :content, e.message.remove("[stdin]:")
notes: the pinned gemset carries no coffee-script and no execjs, so the COMPILER is a stand-in: it raises the error class the body's own rescue names (ExecJS::RuntimeError), and the capture records how the body handles that error. The body itself is the gem's own bytes
double_rule: every collaborator RECORDS; an answer the spec did not supply is the recording double's own answer, and the capture names the answers the spec supplied

scenarios.scenario: a coffee script the compiler refuses: the body adds the compiler's message, with the stdin marker removed
